title: Placed gameplay objects

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

world.description: Name of the world (level) the objects are in.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

units.description: Unit of every distance in the file.

id.description: Stable id derived from the placed actor's name and the level it is in.

kind.description: What the object is: a shop (`equipment-vendor`, `vehicle-vendor`, `garage-vendor`), a team `safe-zone` with its `safe-zone-camera`, a team `spawn-manager`, a `spawn-volume` that vehicles appear in, a `vehicle-deployment-board` or a `fuel-refill` crate.

yaw.description: Heading in degrees. Absent when the object is not rotated.

scale.description: Actor scale as stored. For a safe zone this sizes its trigger box. Absent when the game leaves it at 1.

faction.description: The team the object belongs to (`Alpha` or `Bravo`). Absent for neutral objects.

tags.description: Tags the object applies to people inside it (safe zones).

allowedVehicles.description: Vehicle ids a spawn volume may spawn (see items.json).

disallowedVehicles.description: Vehicle ids and vehicle families a spawn volume never spawns.

objects.description: Objects, sorted by kind and then position.

description: Gameplay objects placed in one world: shops, safe zones, spawn managers and volumes, vehicle deployment boards and fuel refills. Coordinates are the same as in map.json.
